product_version.description: The version the report says it evaluated, verbatim. Null when the report names only a product line.

template_version.description: The VPAT template version printed on the report, such as 2.5Rev. Null when absent.

report_date.description: YYYY-MM of the report date. Null when absent.

evaluation_date.description: YYYY-MM of the evaluation date in the methods section, when it differs from the report date. Null when absent.

assistive_technologies.description: Each named screen reader, magnifier, voice control or keyboard-only testing, as written.

interfaces_covered.description: Each product, interface or platform the report says it covers, such as web app, iOS app, admin console.

author_relationship.description: third_party only when the report names an outside firm as the evaluator.

scope_carve_outs.description: Notes that exclude part of the product from the evaluation.

design_intent_language.description: Claims about intent instead of behaviour, such as 'designed to be accessible'.

nonstandard_terms.description: Conformance terms outside Supports, Partially Supports, Does Not Support, Not Applicable and Not Evaluated, as written.

rows.description: Every criterion row in every conformance table, in document order.

table.description: The table the row sits in, such as 'WCAG 2.1 Level A', 'Section 508 Chapter 3', 'Chapter 5 Software'.

criterion.description: The criterion number as printed, such as 1.1.1 or 302.1 or 502.3.1.

remarks.description: The Remarks and Explanations cell, verbatim. Empty string when blank.

remark_reason.description: One sentence naming what in the remark sets its type.

features_named.description: Pages, screens, components or workflows the remark names.

hedged.description: The remark qualifies its claim with some, most, generally, may or similar.

contradicts_rating.description: The remark describes a failure under a Supports rating, or full support under a failing rating.

affected_groups.description: Functional groups the remark names or the failure plainly affects. Empty when the remark gives no basis.

reading_notes.description: Anything about the document that limits the extraction: unreadable pages, tables split across pages, a second product in the same file.
